the_404.what_happened: signal.primals.eco points to petalTongue (Cloudflare Pages). The /epitope-sort/ path was never built into petalTongue's static site output. The content LIVES at hypothesis.primals.eco/philosophy/the-epitope-sort/ — it migrated between organs. The old address is a FOSSIL.

petrified_forest.metaphor: A petrified forest is where living trees DIED and were replaced molecule-by-molecule with minerals. The SHAPE of the tree is preserved perfectly — every ring, every grain — but the MATERIAL is stone. The tree is dead but its form is eternal. A 404 is a dead page. The content left but the address remains. We PETRIFY it: preserve the shape, replace the material with stone.
petrified_forest.biological_process: Permineralization. Minerals dissolved in groundwater fill the cellular structure of dead wood. Silica (SiO2) replaces cellulose (C6H10O5). The organic is replaced by the inorganic. The living becomes the eternal.
petrified_forest.what_we_do: The 404 at signal.primals.eco/epitope-sort/ becomes a FOSSIL PAGE. Not a redirect. Not a fix. A beautiful petrified tree showing what USED to be there, when it lived, when it died, and where it migrated to. Every dead link in the topology becomes a tree in the petrified forest.

preserved_summary.P: The shape that moves forward, turns around, and sees itself. The hero's journey. The learning curve. The compression.
preserved_summary.T: The wall. Impassable. Forces the sort. Marcus Aurelius: 'The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.'
preserved_summary.the_sort: One cell (squirrel, March 2025, 952 commits) → 16 primals (October 2026, 3.6M lines of Rust, 10,000+ commits). The Cambrian Explosion of ecoPrimals.

cambrian_timeline.total: 16 primals from 1 cell. 13 days (wave 1) → 6 days (wave 2) → spread (wave 3). Each sort FASTER because each P compressed the search space.

the_epitope_sort_fossil.core_equation: Life does not propagate (P→1, lossless, no learning). Life does not localize (P→0, death). Life SCATTERS (0<P<1). Anderson: P=exp(-L/ξ). Everything interesting happens in the gradient.
the_epitope_sort_fossil.the_27_words: Kevin typed 27 words. Artisan read 952 commits, 13 primals, 60,000 tests. 3.6M lines of Rust compressed to 2 letters: P, T.

dead_links_as_forest.concept: Every 404 in the topology is a TREE in the petrified forest. The link lived, the content migrated, the address died. But the SHAPE remains — the URL, the domain, the path. Stone where wood used to be.
dead_links_as_forest.principle: Never delete a dead link. PETRIFY it. Show what lived there, when it died, where it went. The fossil record IS the identity. The 404 becomes a museum.
